messages:
jess: heads-up: quick bring-up of mosaic-v2-vectorizer (quant7 int8) on staging. initial semantic-sim tests show recall@10 drop for short queries. logs + repro below.

sam: oh no, numbers?

jess: here's the smoke run output i used — quick glance: 
```
# run: pytest tests/evals/sem_sim.py::short_query_recall --model mosaic-v2-q7 --k 10
Baseline (mosaic-v1-fp16): recall@10 = 0.842
mosaic-v2-q7 (staging):    recall@10 = 0.779
long-query recall@10: v1=0.893 v2=0.887
```

mike: interesting — short queries only. Did you check whitening / L2-normalize postproc?

jess: yes, tried l2_norm after embedding, no meaningful change. distributions shifted (angles), t-SNE shows clusters but centroids moved relative to anchors.

sara: can you paste a failing sample pair?

jess: sure — one quick example: 
```
query: "reset password link not working"
gold:  "how to reset my password"
baseline sim=0.71
v2 sim=0.58
```

sam: that smells like quant calibration. Are we using per-channel quantization or per-tensor?

jess: staging run used per-tensor symmetric int8 with global clamp from calibration. i'll try per-channel asymmetric next.

eval-bot: Benchmark job #4512 finished: diff report -> precision@10 delta -6.4% in short-query bucket (see /bench/4512/report.json)

mike: :thinking: could also be tokenizer differences — mosaic-v2 has updated merges and slightly different tokenization path. Might change subword boundaries for short queries.

sara: i'll kick off a targeted holdout that normalizes tokenization (force v1 merges) to rule that out. spinning up run now.

jess: :thumbsup: thanks. if per-channel fixes it we can update quant profile; otherwise revert quant and keep v2 as fp16 behind a canary.

sam: also add silhouette score + cluster centroid shift metric for short-query bucket. if centroids moved, silhouette will show it.

jess: plan of action:
1) try per-channel asymmetric int8 profile (by EOD)
2) run 1M short-query holdout with tokenization control
3) compute recall@k, precision@k, silhouette, centroid-drift
4) decide roll/rollback and update rollout policy

sara: starting run now, ETA ~2h.

sam: cc: @infra-bot can you allocate staging gpu?

infra-bot: infra-bot: allocation request accepted — 1x A10 reserved on staging-2 (ticket #8231)

jess: noted. i'll post results here when per-channel run finishes.

sara: quick update — tokenization-controlled run finished: delta unchanged. seems tokenization not root cause.

jess: per-channel quant run finished: recall@10 = 0.835 (staging per-channel asymmetric), still slightly < baseline but much closer (baseline 0.842). silhouette delta reduced from -0.12 to -0.03.

mike: nice, that suggests quantization scheme was majority of degradation.

sam: recommend pushing per-channel quant profile to staging-2 canary and re-run 5x to be sure.

jess: agreed — pushing profile now to canary. will monitor eval job and open a rollout PR if stable.

sara: ping when you open the PR, i'll run the extended holdout overnight.

jess: will do. tagging for visibility @mike @sam @sara.
